title: GeoCoinFlip
description: This is a Minecraft COINFLIP plugin !
body:
🪙 Ultimate CoinFlip • Double or Nothing! 🚀
Bring the ultimate adrenaline rush to your server! No heavy menus, no lag. Just fast-paced, high-stakes betting right from the chat. Will you double your money or lose it all? 💸

✨ **Key Features**

💬 **Chat-Based Betting**: Create and accept coinflip challenges instantly with simple commands!

⏳ **Expiration Timer**: Challenges don't last forever! Bets automatically expire and refund after a customizable timeout period if no one accepts.

⚠️ **Economy Requirement**: Works seamlessly via Vault (Requires both Vault and a Vault-compatible economy plugin to function!).

🎮 **Commands**
/coinflip <amount> <heads/tails> — Challenge the server!

/cf accept <player> — Take the risk and accept a bet!

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

⚡ Lightweight • Exploits Free • Boost your Server Economy! Download now!
